dan.auditor: Hi team — auditor here. Need to collect evidence for a SOC2 spot-check. Can you provide: 1) approved RBAC change records (who approved, PR/ID, timestamps), 2) KMS key rotation proof for the last 12 months (rotation events + exported key metadata), 3) audit log extracts showing rolebinding modifications, 4) vuln triage tickets linked to any incidents in that period. We need downloadable artifacts (S3 or internal share) and a short description of collection steps. Target: folder per control. Deadline: EOD Thursday. Thanks.

olivia_compliance: Thanks Dan — we can assemble. Quick clarifying q's: a) For RBAC do you want cluster-level rolebinding diffs only or also application-level IAM changes? b) Preferred log window? Last 12 months by default. c) Need signed attestations or just exported artifacts?

dan.auditor: a) cluster-level + cloud IAM role changes (GCP/IAM or AWS IAM). b) 12 months is fine. c) exported artifacts are fine; if you can include a short attestation note that these are full exports and context, that helps.

maria_security: Ok — mapping plan: - RBAC: collect k8s audit snapshots + GitHub PRs for rbac-config repo (PRs include approvals). Artifacts: s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/2026/rbac-snapshots/ and PR list CSV. Example PR: github.com/redwood/rbac-config/pull/4212 (approved by @jake_eng on 2026-02-15).

maria_security: - KMS: key rotation events exported from CloudKMS + HSM audit logs. We have rotation events in key-manager logs with event IDs. Artifact example: s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/2026/kms-rotation/rotation-2026-03-12-keys.json. Key rotation schedule is monthly; last rotation for primary-prod key = 2026-03-12.

jake_eng: For rolebinding diffs I can export snapshots using our infra tool. Command I used: ```rbac-export --cluster prod --since 2025-03-01 --out /tmp/rbac-snapshots.json``` Then we push to S3: ```aws s3 cp /tmp/rbac-snapshots.json s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/2026/rbac-snapshots/```. PR evidence: GH API query `gh pr list --repo redwood/rbac-config --search "merged:>2025-03-01" --json number,title,author,mergedAt,reviewRequests`.

splunk-bot: Saved search "SOC2_RBAC_Changes_12m" results exported: https://splunk.redwood.internal/app/search/SA-SOC2_RBAC_Changes_12m/export.csv (requires SSO).

olivia_compliance: Vuln triage linkage: we will include a CSV mapping vuln ID -> triage ticket -> incident if any. Example: VULN-2026-017 -> GH issue #4521 -> Incident INC-2026-015 (patch deployed 2026-01-10). Path: s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/2026/vuln-mappings/vuln-incident-mapping.csv

dan.auditor: Good. A couple more specifics: 1) For KMS can you include the key metadata (fingerprint, rotation timestamp, who initiated rotation) and KMS audit log raw export (time-windowed). 2) For RBAC we need the approval chain (who approved in GitHub + any slack approvals). 3) Please confirm log retention windows and that exports are complete (e.g., no gaps).

maria_security: Affirmative on KMS metadata. We'll pull CloudKMS audit sink in JSONL and include the event.metadata fields (principal, requestId, timestamp). Example file: rotation-2026-03-12-event-8a7f.jsonl. Initiator shown as serviceAccount:rotation-bot@redwood-infra. We'll add a small attestation file signed by security lead (text file) noting completeness and retention policy references (retention: audit logs 3 years in archival bucket).

jake_eng: For GitHub approvals, I'll include PR review records + any linked slack threads. Slack approvals are archived via our approval-bot which stores messages at: s3://redwood-internal/approvals/slack-approvals/2026-*.jsonl. I'll include the filtered set for the 12-month window.

dan.auditor: Can you also include Splunk queries you ran (so we can re-run) and any saved dashboards used? Need proof of reproducibility.

jake_eng: Splunk query snippet I'll attach. Example: ```index=infra_logs event_type=rbac_change | stats count by user,object,action,ts | where ts>=relative_time(now(), "-12mon")``` Saved dashboard: SOC2_RBAC_Audit (permissions: compliance+security).

maria_security: Timeline: We'll aim to upload a tarball to s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/2026/evidence-payload-2178004321.tar.gz by Thu EOD. Will include a manifest: manifest-2178004321.json (manifest will list files + sha256 + human notes).

dan.auditor: Perfect. One last ask: include a short note on exception handling — any RBAC emergency changes over the window, link to incident and post-fix review.

\olivia_compliance: We'll include an exceptions.csv with columns: change_id, approver, emergency_reason, incident_id, postmortem_link. Example row: RBAC-2026-011, jake_eng, urgent hotfix for service outage, INC-2026-009, https://redwood/pms/postmortems/INC-2026-009

dan.auditor: Thanks all. I'll look for the tarball and manifest. If anything slips, ping me here. :thumbsup:
